newsitem.title: USA: Dynamics Corp stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Dynamics Corp stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Tuesday it had cut its stake in Dynamics Corp of America to 863,600 shares, or 22.65 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included a net 33,200 shares sold between October 22 and December 17 at prices ranging from $26.4667 to $29 per share.

Dynamics of Greenwich, Conn., designs, manufactures and markets a variety of electrical appliances and electronic devices, fabricated metal products and equipment, and power and controlled environmental systems.
